title: Passenger shot multiple times; driver now behind bars a month later, court records say
text:
A man has been arrested and charged more than a month after a shooting in Columbus' Linden neighborhood left another man critically injured.
A man has been arrested and charged more than a month after a shooting in Columbus' Linden neighborhood left another man critically injured. A man has been arrested and charged more than a month after a shooting in Columbus' Linden neighborhood left another man critically injured.
According to Franklin County Municipal Court records, 25-year-old Ke'anu Anthony Logan was booked into the Franklin County Jail on Wednesday. Logan faces multiple charges, including felonious assault, improperly discharging a firearm over a roadway, having weapons while under disability, improperly handling a firearm in a motor vehicle and possession of dangerous ordnance. The charges stem from a shooting that happened around 2:46 a.m. on June 7 in the 900 block of East 22nd Ave.
Columbus Police said officers found a man suffering from a gunshot wound and rushed him to Grant Medical Center in critical condition. According to court documents obtained by ABC 6 through a public records request, investigators identified the victim as Dwaun Patterson, who suffered multiple gunshot wounds to his shoulder, wrist and abdomen. These documents said detectives were unable to speak with him due to him being placed in a medically induced coma.
Detectives say surveillance video showed Patterson leaving a club in a dark-colored sedan driven by Logan before he was shot. Evidence indicates Patterson was shot by someone inside the vehicle after it stopped on East 22nd Ave. , according to court documents. Investigators also recovered shell casings and determined the firearm used was operating as a fully automatic weapon.
Court records further state Logan was prohibited from possessing a firearm because of a previous robbery conviction in Franklin County. The shooting remains under investigation.
